schema.description:
Request of `POST /b/dev/api/builds/stage`.

One compiled `wasm32-wasip1` module, with everything needed to explain it
afterwards. Staging validates the artifact and, if it passes, activates a
new generation carrying it — there is no separate "activate" call.

artifact_base64.description:
The compiled module, standard base64 with padding. At most 4 MiB
decoded.

block_name.description:
The block's short name, e.g. `hello` for the sources under
`blocks/hello/`. It is registered as `site/hello` and serves
`/b/hello/`; do not send either of those longer forms.

compiler_version.description: Pinned toolchain revision that produced the artifact.

diagnostics.description:
Diagnostics the compiler produced, warnings included. They are stored
with the build and returned alongside any the validator adds.

items.description: One thing the compiler or the validator has to say about a build.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable identifier, e.g. `cap-collection` for a
capability outside the block's namespace or `guest-init` for a trap
in the guest's `Init`. Match on this rather than on `message`.

`null` when whoever produced the diagnostic had no code for it. Every
diagnostic the sandbox's own validator produces has one, but a
*compiler* diagnostic need not: rustc numbers some of what it says
(`E0425`) and not the rest, and the page forwards what the compiler
gave it.

column.description: 1-based column in `file`, when the compiler reported one.

file.description:
Workspace-relative source file the diagnostic is about, when the
compiler reported one.

line.description: 1-based line in `file`, when the compiler reported one.

message.description: What is wrong, and what to change.

severity.description: How serious it is. Anything `error` means the build was refused.

oneOf.description: The build is refused, or the compile failed.
The build stands; something is worth changing.
Additional context for a nearby error or warning.
A suggested fix.

source_manifest_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the source manifest the compile ran against, so a stored
build can be traced back to the exact sources. Omit if the compiler
did not report one.

wafer_guest_version.description:
The `WAFER_GUEST_VERSION` of the `wafer_guest` crate the compiler
session was started with: `version` from `GET /b/dev/api/guest`.

A value that is not the sandbox's own is refused with a
`wafer-guest-version` diagnostic: the guest crate IS the ABI, so a
block built against an older copy is talking a contract this runtime
no longer speaks. Reload the workspace page (a fresh compiler session
fetches and builds the current crate) and compile again.

Omit it only if the compiler session has no guest crate. It is then
recorded as `0` — "unknown" — and nothing is checked.

get.description: The `wafer_guest` crate every block depends on by path, plus the block the compiler builds once at session start to warm it. The page fetches this before starting the toolchain; an agent only needs it to read the SDK's source.

schema.description:
Response of `GET /b/dev/api/guest`.

Everything the compiler session needs before the first compile: the
guest crate a block depends on, and a block to build it with.

version.description:
`WAFER_GUEST_VERSION` of the crate below. A block compiled in a
session started from this response reports this number to
`POST /b/dev/api/builds/stage`.

warmup.description:
The `hello` template scaffolded as `hello`: what the compiler builds
once at start-up so the crate above is compiled before any real block.

crate_name.description:
Cargo's package name, which names the artifact and the VFS directory:
the crate is built at `blocks/<crate_name>/`, with `blocks/` beside
`wafer_guest/`, which is the layout its `../../wafer_guest` dependency
needs.

schema.title: GuestResponse

get.summary: The guest SDK crate the compiler builds against

get.description: The guide for writing a block: the wafer_guest crate's API, the database / storage / config services, the namespace and capability rules, the limits, the diagnostic codes, and both templates in full.

markdown.description:
The backend-block (Rust) authoring guide, as Markdown: the API, the
host services, the namespace rules, the limits, the diagnostic codes,
and both templates in full.

site_markdown.description:
This sandbox's site-authoring guide, as Markdown: the CSS framework
it ships, the page skeleton, the storefront element, the catalog API,
what a write refuses. Read it before writing under `site/`. Null when
the seed carried none.

suggested_prompt.description:
The task this template was designed to walk an agent through, as the
workspace page suggests it. Empty when the template suggests none or
the sandbox carries no seed.

template.description:
The template this sandbox was seeded from (`dev_status.template`), or
null when the seed carried no sandbox block.

wafer_guest_version.description:
The `WAFER_GUEST_VERSION` of the guest SDK crate this reference
documents and every scaffolded block depends on.

activation.description: The activation in progress, if any.

detail.description: Human-readable detail for the progress panel.

oneOf.description: Nothing in flight.
Hashes, manifests and guests are being checked.
A candidate runtime is being constructed from the block set.
The site files are being written into `wafer-run/web/site`.
The generation is live.
The activation was abandoned; the previous generation is still live.

active_generation.description: The active generation, or null on a fresh instance.

activated_at.description: RFC 3339 time the generation went live, or null if it never did.

blocks.description: Number of blocks in the generation's block manifest.

oneOf.description: A `site/**` write. Site-only — no runtime rebuild.
A `site/**` delete. Site-only — no runtime rebuild.
A successful compile stage; the block set changed.
A block was removed; the block set changed.
A republish of an earlier generation's manifests.
Generation 0, imported from the seed bundle on cold boot.

parent_id.description: The generation this one was derived from, or null for the first.

site_files.description: Number of files in the generation's site manifest.

status.description: Where the generation sits in its lifecycle.

oneOf.description: Recorded, not yet examined.
Blobs, artifacts and guests are being checked.
The runtime swap and site publish are in progress.
Currently serving.

Abandoned: its validation or activation failed, the sandbox stopped
before its activation finished, or on the next start its stored
manifest could not be read back.

No longer serving — replaced by a later generation.

Written by the activation that replaced it, and by nothing else. It is
not an ageing marker: a generation that falls out of the retention
window is deleted rather than relabelled, so a `failed` generation
still reads as `failed` for as long as the ledger keeps it.

items.description: A block serving in the active generation.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact the block was loaded from, hex-encoded.

routes.description:
Route prefixes the block serves, with the access tier the router
enforces for each.

items.description: One route prefix a dynamically-registered block serves.

access.description: Access tier the router enforces for the prefix.

oneOf.description: No auth check; anyone may reach the route.
A resolved user identity is required.
The `admin` role is required.

runtime_generation.description:
Bumped on every runtime rebuild; the page refreshes tool registrations
when it changes.

seed_error.description:
Why this instance's seed import was refused, if it was.

`null` on every healthy instance — including one that never had a
seed bundle to import. A sandbox whose seed was refused boots with an
empty site and no other sign of it, so this is where the cause is
read. An admin sees the same text on `/b/admin/settings/variables`.

storage.description: What the sandbox's content stores hold right now.

artifacts.description: How many compiled block artifacts are stored.

artifacts_bytes.description: Total size of those artifacts, in bytes.

blobs.description:
How many content-addressed blobs are stored. Includes blobs no file
names any more but a retained generation still does.

blobs_bytes.description: Total size of those blobs, in bytes.

retained_generations.description:
How many generations the ledger is keeping: the retention window, plus
anything older that is still serving or still in flight.

workspace_files.description: How many files the workspace currently holds.

template.description:
The template this sandbox was seeded from, or null when the seed
carried no sandbox block. What an agent reads to know which guide
`dev_read_reference.site_markdown` will be.

wafer_guest_version.description:
`WAFER_GUEST_VERSION` of the `wafer_guest` crate this sandbox serves
(`GET /b/dev/api/guest`) and compiles blocks against.
